title: Round B phone polish on watch/finish
author: Blitzwing /nyborg
body: Watch and finish on a phone: the finish/share card scrolls into view, Again sits beside a clear New seed, and the Race my Nyborg link wraps so you can read it.
The address bar now carries the guest-safe viewer query during a race, Pause/speed targets are larger, and play assets are cache-busted again.
next: Splash default seed on nyborgs; freeze the friend-playtest field-note template.
